# pangolin_resource_rule (Resource)

Manages an access control rule for a Pangolin HTTP resource. Rules are evaluated in priority order and control which requests are accepted, dropped, or passed through.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Allow only internal CIDR range
resource "pangolin_resource_rule" "allow_internal" {
  resource_id = pangolin_resource.example.id
  action      = "ACCEPT"
  match       = "CIDR"
  value       = "10.0.0.0/8"
  priority    = 1
  enabled     = true
}

# Block a specific country
resource "pangolin_resource_rule" "block_country" {
  resource_id = pangolin_resource.example.id
  action      = "DROP"
  match       = "COUNTRY"
  value       = "CN"
  priority    = 10
}

# Drop every request from outside France. DROP ends evaluation for the
# requests it matches; only French requests go on to the later rules.
resource "pangolin_resource_rule" "france_only" {
  resource_id = pangolin_resource.example.id
  action      = "DROP"
  match       = "COUNTRY_IS_NOT"
  value       = "FR"
  priority    = 20
}

# Drop write methods (comma-separated list)
resource "pangolin_resource_rule" "read_only" {
  resource_id = pangolin_resource.example.id
  action      = "DROP"
  match       = "METHOD"
  value       = "POST,PUT,PATCH,DELETE"
  priority    = 30
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) The rule action: `ACCEPT`, `DROP`, or `PASS`.
- `match` (String) The match type: `CIDR`, `IP`, `PATH`, `COUNTRY`, `COUNTRY_IS_NOT`, `ASN`, `REGION`, `METHOD`. `COUNTRY_IS_NOT` matches requests from any country except `value`. `COUNTRY_IS_NOT`, `REGION` and `METHOD` need a Pangolin server that supports them (1.24 accepts all of them).
- `priority` (Number) The rule priority (lower number = higher priority).
- `resource_id` (Number) The ID of the resource this rule belongs to.
- `value` (String) The value to match against. The server checks its format against `match`: a CIDR range for `CIDR` (e.g. `10.0.0.0/8`), an IP address for `IP`, a URL glob pattern for `PATH` (e.g. `/admin/*`), an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for `COUNTRY` and `COUNTRY_IS_NOT` (e.g. `FR`), an ASN for `ASN` (e.g. `AS13335`), a UN M49 region code for `REGION` (e.g. `150` for Europe, `015` for Northern Africa), or a comma-separated list of HTTP methods for `METHOD` (e.g. `POST,PUT,DELETE`).

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is enabled. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The numeric rule ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import pangolin_resource_rule.example <resource_id>/<rule_id>
```
